title: Reading together
observation: Two children took turns searching for a character in a picture book, celebrated discoveries and independently selected another book.
analysis: Shared attention, visual discrimination, persistence and verbal communication.
extension: Offer interactive reading with prediction and searching, and book sorting.

title: Collaborative puzzle play
observation: Three children worked together on a puzzle. One changed strategy when a piece did not fit; the group celebrated completion.
analysis: Spatial reasoning, cognitive flexibility, cooperation and confidence.
extension: Offer more complex puzzles and invite children to explain their strategies.

title: Measuring everyday objects
observation: Following a height-measuring lesson, two children compared their drink bottles using fingers as informal units.
analysis: Transfer of learning, comparative vocabulary and early measurement.
extension: Provide rulers, blocks and a measurement station for comparing classroom objects.

title: Imaginative caregiving
observation: Two children dressed, fed and settled dolls while sharing an imaginative caregiving narrative.
analysis: Symbolic thinking, sequencing, empathy and expressive language.
extension: Provide diverse caregiving props and picture cards for everyday routines.

title: Clay modelling
observation: Two children requested additional clay to create a butterfly and a pretend pizza. One used pumpkin seeds to represent toppings.
analysis: Purposeful design, symbolic representation, fine motor coordination and communication.
extension: Explore butterfly collages and pizza-shop dramatic play with menus.

title: Building a city
observation: A child independently built a city using LEGO and described its buildings, lights and trees.
analysis: Spatial awareness, symbolic thinking and connections with the local environment.
extension: Invite city mapping and provide construction materials and traffic signs.

title: Investigating plant growth
observation: During a vegetable regrowth activity, a child asked whether apples grow in the same way and whether they also need water. The educator discussed plant growth requirements.
analysis: Inquiry, comparison and emerging understanding of living things.
extension: Create a growth journal and investigate the effects of water and light.

title: Colour mixing inquiry
observation: A child mixing blue and yellow paint asked whether adding more blue would produce darker green. The educator invited experimentation.
analysis: Prediction, cause-and-effect reasoning and creative exploration.
extension: Explore different paint ratios and record observations.

title: Exploring ecosystems
observation: A child assembling soil, plants and pebbles asked about the role of each component. The educator explained how elements support life.
analysis: Curiosity about natural systems and relationships between living things and their environment.
extension: Explore local nature and create drawings of ecosystem components.

title: Caring for the garden
observation: Two children took turns watering plants and discussed how much water was appropriate.
analysis: Environmental responsibility, cooperation and emerging scientific understanding.
extension: Establish a garden care routine and record plant growth.

title: From independent to shared construction
observation: One child wanted to build independently. The educator acknowledged both children’s preferences and offered separate materials. The children later chose to combine their buildings into a city.
analysis: Agency, negotiation, spatial reasoning and peer collaboration.
extension: Offer optional cooperative construction challenges and city planning materials.
